name: Moreh
source_label: Tengnoupal District Administration — Health (Govt Hospitals) + Helpline; Moreh PS via tengnoupal.nic.in

fields.police_address: Moreh Bazar, Moreh Town, Moreh Sub-Division

notes: Moreh Hospital listed on https://tengnoupal.nic.in/health/ — govt 'List of Government Hospitals' page lists Moreh Hospital with phone shown as '961268419' (this is a 9-digit number — almost certainly a printed-typo for 9612684819 per cross-mapped Mappls listing; left phone OUT of payload to avoid life-safety risk from publishing wrong digit count). The Sub-Divisional Hospital Moreh was non-operational from the May 2023 ethnic clashes until reopening Feb 2025 — per news reporting, not in payload. Moreh Police Station (OC: Inspector Letkhohao Vaiphei) at Moreh Bazar, Moreh Sub-Division, listed phones 8730860229 / 7005147026 on https://tengnoupal.nic.in/police/ — phones left out of main payload as one is mobile and OC name implies handset-rotation; police_address kept. Helplines from https://tengnoupal.nic.in/helpline/ (100/101/102/181/1098). Indo-Myanmar border town — AFSPA active in many areas. Army/Assam Rifles direct contact NOT published on .nic.in for civilian use → omitted (do not fabricate). Pharmacy/mechanic/tow/guesthouse/EN-doctor not on any .nic.in page → null. SECURITY ADVISORY: Moreh is at the international Indo-Myanmar border with Tamu, Myanmar; AFSPA is active across Tengnoupal district; ongoing ethnic violence since May 2023 (Meitei-Kuki) was particularly intense in Moreh — town is mixed Kuki/Meitei/Tamil. Inner Line Permit (ILP) required for non-Manipuri Indians. STRONGLY recommend visitor briefing with district SP Tengnoupal AND Assam Rifles sector HQ before travel; check Indo-Myanmar border crossing status.
